title: Normalise amounts that arrive as numbers, text or nothing
examObjective: Converting between output types and data types using DataWeave
basics: `match` picks a branch by testing a value: `case n is Number -> ...` runs when the value is a Number, `case null -> ...` when it is null, and `else -> ...` catches anything left. Cases are tried from top to bottom and the first that fits wins.
prompt:
Payments reach the ledger from three systems. One sends `amount` as a Number, one as text such as `"12.50"`, and one leaves it `null` for zero-value transactions.

Return every amount as a Number: a Number stays as it is, numeric text is converted, and `null` becomes `0`. Anything that cannot be read as a number, such as `"n/a"`, becomes `null` so the ledger can flag it.
hints: Branch on the type of each value.
What should happen to `"n/a"`? And is that the same as what should happen to null?
For text, `($ as Number) default null` turns unreadable text into null. For null itself, return 0.
solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload map ($ match {
  case n is Number -> n
  case null -> 0
  case s is String -> (s as Number) default null
  else -> null
})

mustFail.why: coerces everything with a single fallback of 0, so unreadable text is booked as zero instead of flagged
mustFail.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload map (($ as Number) default 0)

mustFail.why: has no case for null, so a zero-value transaction falls through to else and becomes null
mustFail.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload map ($ match {
  case n is Number -> n
  case s is String -> (s as Number) default null
  else -> null
})

explanation.approach: Two different "no number" situations need two different answers: null means zero, and junk text means unknown. A single coercion with a fallback cannot tell them apart; a `match` on the type can.

snippets.label: Unreadable text with a fallback
snippets.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
("n/a" as Number) default null

snippets.label: A null case
snippets.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
null match { case n is Number -> n case null -> 0 else -> -1 }
